node.statement: Ruan block estimate: for Z in M_{2n} tensor S_P written as a 2-by-2 matrix (Z_ij) of n-by-n blocks, the operator-space matrix axioms give ||Z||<=2*max_{i,j}||Z_ij|| (factor Z=A*diag(Z_11,Z_12,Z_21,Z_22)*B with scalar A,B of norms sqrt(2)). Since T_{2n} is the entrywise amplification of T_n, compression to its (i,j) target block gives ||T_{2n}(Z)||>=max_{i,j}||T_n(Z_ij)||. Hence ||T_{2n}(Z)||>=a_n*max||Z_ij||>=a_n||Z||/2 and therefore a_{2n}>=a_n/2.
